notes:
Account: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics for e-commerce platforms). Evaluating Redwood as primary inference layer for chat-based support assistant + semantic doc search and reranking for recommendations. Short bullets: 
- Primary goal: replace in-house LLM infra with managed inference to reduce ops burden and get predictable latency/costs. 
- Target workloads: conversational support (80% of tokens short, 20% long context up to 4k), nightly batch reranking for recommendations (embedding + rerank) and ad-hoc summarization. Latency SLOs: p95 < 120ms for chat read path, throughput 200 RPS for embeddings during peaks. 
- Cost sensitivity: unit economics must be comparable to current self-hosted when including infra and on-call (customer target ARR band $75-200k). 
- POC notes: using Hosted API sandbox with 2-week sample traffic replay. Initial findings: batching could cut token cost ~18% for rerank batch jobs; prefix/KV caching shows 25-40% reduction on repeated conversational sessions; 4-bit quantization profiles acceptable for rerank-only model variants; generation quality needs regression checks vs prod prompts. 
- Security: requires SSO/SAML, SOC2 compliance evidence, audit logs retention 1 year, optional KMS integration for key management, data residency preference (US-only). 
- Pricing conversation: comparing two options — Hosted (pay-as-you-go) vs Dedicated reserved pool (monthly commit). Customer leans to start with Hosted for fast time-to-value then convert to Dedicated once steady throughput established. Need clear cost break-even modeling. 
- Workshop planned: 60-90 minute cost-optimization session with product+engineering leads and Redwood SE to deep dive on batching strategies, cache TTLs, quantization tradeoffs, and traffic shaping. Deliverable: unit economics sheet and suggested Dedicated capacity profile. 
- Quote/ask from customer: 'show us the math — if Dedicated saves >30% total token ops cost at 1M tokens/day we can commit'. 
- AE notes: push for early commitment via 3-month pilot discount; prepare security pack and SOC2 evidence for legal next week. 
- Next steps: schedule workshop (target week of 2026-03-22), finalize POC benchmark scripts, produce cost modeling doc, engage finance for pilot pricing approval.
